# auto_focus

Whether to focus the composer automatically when a channel is selected.
Set to false to preview channels without moving focus.

Default: `true`

# mouse

Whether to enable the mouse.

Default: `true`

# windows_terminal

On Windows, whether discordo opens itself in Windows Terminal when it is started in the old console
window, which shows neither emoji nor sharp images.

Default: `true`

# watch_paste_key

On Windows, whether discordo watches for ctrl+v while its terminal has the focus, to paste images in
Windows Terminal, which keeps the key for itself and pastes only text. Removing ctrl+v from Windows
Terminal's actions does the same without it. Off, as antivirus programs take a program that watches keys
for one that logs them.

Default: `false`

# editor

The program opened by the `composer.open_editor` keybind. "default" uses `$EDITOR`.

Default: `"default"`

# status

"default" (unknown), "online", "dnd", "idle", "invisible" or "offline".

Default: `"default"`

# hide_blocked_users

Default: `true`

# messages_limit

The number of messages to fetch when a text-based channel is selected, from 1 to 100.

Default: `50`

# voice

## voice.sensitivity

How loud the microphone must be for what is said to be sent, in dB below the loudest it can be.

Default: `-40.0`

## voice.volume

How loud everyone is played, in percent.

Default: `100`

## voice.volume_step

How much louder or quieter, in percent, a voice member is played per keypress.

Default: `10`

## voice.input_device

The name of the microphone, as the settings page (ctrl+s) lists it, or "" for the system's default.

Default: `""`

## voice.output_device

The name of the speakers or headset, as the settings page lists them, or "" for the system's default.

Default: `""`

## voice.push_to_talk

The key held to be heard, wherever the focus is, which only Windows lets a program in a terminal read:
"mouse4", "mouse5", "capslock", "rightctrl", "rightalt", "backtick", "f13" or "scrolllock". "" sends what
is said whenever it is louder than the sensitivity.

Default: `""`

## voice.noise_suppression

Whether the noise around what you say, such as fans, typing and traffic, is removed before it is sent,
with RNNoise. It also keeps noise from being sent as if you spoke. The settings page (ctrl+s) turns it on
and off at once.

Default: `true`

## voice.echo_cancellation

Whether what your speakers play, which the microphone picks up, is removed from what is sent, for others
not to hear themselves back. Not needed with a headset. The settings page (ctrl+s) turns it on and off at
once.

Default: `false`

# activity

What others see you doing, as Discord shows under your name, taken from the programs you have open.
Nothing is looked at until it is enabled. The settings page (ctrl+s) turns it on, and its "Programs shown
as my activity" page adds the programs that are open, names them as others should see them, and orders
them.

## activity.enabled

Whether discordo looks at the windows that are open, every 15 seconds, to show the first of programs that
has one. Off, so that nothing is looked at unless you want it.

Default: `false`

## activity.programs

The programs that are shown, in the order they are preferred. Programs that are not listed are never shown.
Each is written as

	[[activity.programs]]
	exe = "StarCitizen.exe"  # the name of the program's file, matched without regard to case
	name = "Star Citizen"    # the name others see
	type = "playing"         # "playing", "listening", "watching" or "competing"
	show_title = false       # whether the title of its window, such as Spotify's song, is shown under it

Default: `[]`

# stream

## stream.player

The program that plays a stream's video, which it is given on its standard input. mpv is recommended: it
is given the format and a title, and opens a window of its own.

Default: `"mpv"`

## stream.player_args

The arguments the player is started with. Those of mpv play with little delay, decoding on the GPU where it can.

Default: `["--no-terminal", "--force-window=immediate", "--profile=low-latency", "--untimed", "--cache=no", "--hwdec=auto-safe"]`

# keybinds

Global shortcuts. A keybind is a key such as "ctrl+k", or a list of keys.

## keybinds.toggle_guilds_tree

Hide/show the guilds tree.

Default: `"alt+g"`

## keybinds.toggle_members_tree

Hide/show the members tree.

Default: `"alt+m"`

## keybinds.toggle_channels_picker

Default: `"ctrl+k"`

## keybinds.toggle_mentions_inbox

Show the messages that recently mentioned you, your roles, @everyone or @here, in any server or DM, and jump to the one picked.

Default: `"alt+i"`

## keybinds.toggle_settings

Show the settings page, where settings are changed and saved to the config file.

Default: `["ctrl+s", "alt+,"]`

## keybinds.answer_call

Answer the call ringing the user, which the foot of the messages tells of.

Default: `"alt+a"`

## keybinds.decline_call

Decline the call ringing the user.

Default: `"alt+x"`

## keybinds.toggle_friend_requests

Show the friend requests sent to the user, to accept or ignore. Not alt+r, which the AMD and NVIDIA overlays
take wherever the focus is.

Default: `"ctrl+r"`

## keybinds.widen_sidebar

Widen the server list. Its right edge can also be dragged with the mouse.

Default: `"alt+="`

## keybinds.narrow_sidebar

Narrow the server list.

Default: `"alt+-"`

## keybinds.toggle_mute

Start or stop sending what the microphone captures to the voice channel joined.

Default: `"alt+v"`

## keybinds.toggle_deafen

Stop or start playing what is said in the voice channel joined. Stopping also mutes.

Default: `"alt+d"`

## keybinds.leave_voice

Default: `"alt+l"`

## keybinds.toggle_help

Hide/show keybind help.

Default: `"alt+."`

## keybinds.toggle_full_help

Switch between compact and full keybind help.

Default: `"ctrl+."`

### keybinds.messages_list.search

Search the messages of the channel through Discord's search, and select the result picked.
The query takes Discord's filters: from:user, mentions:user, has:link (or file, image, video, embed, ...), and before:, during: and after: a date as YYYY-MM-DD.
The picker keybinds move through the results, or through the suggestions while typing; the composer's tab_complete completes the selected suggestion.
Select completes an unfinished filter, or else searches, or selects the result if the query is unchanged.

Default: `["/", "ctrl+f"]`

### keybinds.messages_list.yank_id

Default: `"i"`

## keybinds.composer

Only while typing a message.

### keybinds.composer.edit_last

Edit your newest editable message loaded in the current channel, with no age limit.
Only when the composer is empty, with no reply, attachments, or edit in progress.

Default: `"up"`

### keybinds.composer.paste

Paste from clipboard (supports both text and images). Windows Terminal keeps `ctrl+v` for itself, which pastes only
text, so `alt+p` pastes images there.

Default: `["ctrl+v", "alt+p"]`

### keybinds.composer.send

Default: `"enter"`

### keybinds.composer.newline

Insert a new line at the cursor.

Default: `"shift+enter"`

### keybinds.composer.cancel

Remove existing text or cancel reply.

Default: `"esc"`

### keybinds.composer.tab_complete

Complete usernames when mentioning.

Default: `"tab"`

### keybinds.composer.toggle_reply_mention

Toggle whether a reply mentions its author.

Default: `"shift+tab"`

### keybinds.composer.undo

Default: `"ctrl+u"`

### keybinds.composer.open_editor

Default: `"ctrl+e"`

### keybinds.composer.open_file_picker

Default: `"ctrl+\\"`

### keybinds.composer.cursor_left

Move the cursor. Readline's keys, with shift added to those other keybinds take.
Shift with ctrl is told apart from ctrl alone only in terminals with an enhanced keyboard protocol, such as kitty's.

Default: `"ctrl+b"`

### keybinds.composer.cursor_right

Default: `"right"`

### keybinds.composer.cursor_up

Default: `"ctrl+p"`

### keybinds.composer.cursor_down

Default: `"ctrl+n"`

### keybinds.composer.line_start

Default: `"ctrl+a"`

### keybinds.composer.line_end

Default: `"ctrl+shift+e"`

### keybinds.composer.word_left

Move over a word, a run of letters and digits, and what is before it.

Default: `"alt+b"`

### keybinds.composer.word_right

Default: `"alt+f"`

### keybinds.composer.delete_backward

Delete text. Readline's keys, with shift added to those other keybinds take.

Default: `"ctrl+shift+h"`

### keybinds.composer.delete_forward

Default: `"ctrl+shift+d"`

### keybinds.composer.delete_word_backward

Delete what word_left and word_right move over.

Default: `"alt+backspace"`

### keybinds.composer.delete_word_forward

Default: `"alt+shift+d"`

### keybinds.composer.delete_to_space_backward

Delete back to the whitespace before the cursor.

Default: `"ctrl+w"`

### keybinds.composer.delete_to_line_start

Delete to the start or end of the line, or the newline there if the cursor is at it.
Readline deletes to the start of the line with ctrl+u, which is undo here, so it is on ctrl+j.

Default: `"ctrl+j"`

### keybinds.composer.delete_to_line_end

Default: `"ctrl+shift+k"`

## keybinds.autocomplete

Only while the autocomplete is shown.

### keybinds.autocomplete.select_up

Default: `["up", "ctrl+p"]`

### keybinds.autocomplete.select_down

Default: `["down", "ctrl+n"]`

### keybinds.autocomplete.select_top

Default: `"home"`

### keybinds.autocomplete.select_bottom

Default: `"end"`

## keybinds.logout

Log out and remove the authentication token from keyring.
Requires re-login upon restart.

Default: `"ctrl+d"`

## keybinds.quit

Default: `"ctrl+q"`

# theme

Styles of the widgets, each written as
`{ foreground = "", background = "", attributes = "" or ["", ""], underline = "", underline_color = "" }`.

## theme.title

### theme.title.normal_style

Default: `{ attributes = "dim" }`

### theme.title.active_style

The style used while the widget is focused.

Default: `{ foreground = "green", attributes = "bold" }`

## theme.footer

### theme.footer.normal_style

Default: `{ attributes = "dim" }`

### theme.footer.active_style

The style used while the widget is focused.

Default: `{ foreground = "green", attributes = "bold" }`

## theme.border

### theme.border.normal_style

Default: `{ attributes = "dim" }`

### theme.border.active_style

The style used while the widget is focused.

Default: `{ foreground = "green", attributes = "bold" }`

## theme.guilds_tree

The status styles are those of direct-message recipients.

### theme.guilds_tree.graphics_color

### theme.guilds_tree.online_style

Default: `{ foreground = "green" }`

### theme.guilds_tree.idle_style

Default: `{ foreground = "yellow" }`

### theme.guilds_tree.dnd_style

Default: `{ foreground = "red" }`

### theme.guilds_tree.offline_style

Default: `{ foreground = "gray" }`

The style of whoever is speaking in the voice channel joined.

Default: `{ foreground = "green" }`

### theme.guilds_tree.voice_limit_style

The style of how full a voice channel that has a user limit is.

Default: `{ foreground = "dodgerblue" }`
